g.text: Bounded queues isolate a blocked consumer; disconnect joins workers
Bars: medians; dots: 15 runs per dispatch case across 3 processes. Short-loop variation is not a speedup.
M4 / Go 1.27.3 / GOMAXPROCS=1. Synthetic delivery + net.Pipe; not network playback or an implementation A/B.
